items.source: Descriptor for a property-level type along its potential projection that is held within a Collection-like or Map-like container.
items.translation: 描述属性级类型在其潜在投影中的描述符，该投影被包含在类似 Collection 或类似 Map 的容器中。

items.source: Represents a predicate (boolean-valued function) of a target type and its underlying type.
items.translation: 表示一个目标类型及其底层类型的谓词（布尔值函数）。

items.source: A ProxyProjectionFactory that adds support to use Value-annotated methods on a projection interface to evaluate the contained SpEL expression to define the outcome of the method call.
items.translation: 一个 ProxyProjectionFactory，它支持在投影接口上使用带有 Value 注解的方法，以评估所包含的 SpEL 表达式来确定方法调用的结果。

items.source: SPI to create MethodInterceptor instances based on the given source object and the target type to produce.
items.translation: SPI 将根据给定的源对象和目标类型，创建 MethodInterceptor 实例。

items.source: Extension of TargetClassAware to be able to ignore the getter on JSON rendering.
items.translation: 将 TargetClassAware 扩展为能够在 JSON 渲染时忽略 getter。

items.source: Projection subsystem.
items.translation: 投影子系统。

items.source: Helper value to abstract an accessor.
items.translation: 辅助值用于抽象访问器。

items.source: Method interceptor to invoke default methods on the repository proxy.
items.translation: 用于在仓库代理上调用默认方法的拦截器。

items.source: Descriptor for a top-level mapped type representing a view onto a domain type structure.
items.translation: 描述表示对域类型结构视图的顶层映射类型的描述符。

items.source: Projection type.
items.translation: 投影类型。

items.source: Descriptor for a property-level type along its potential projection.
items.translation: 描述属性级类型在其潜在投影上的元数据。

items.source:
This class introspects the returned type in the context of a domain type for all reachable properties (w/o cycles) to
determine which property paths are subject to projection.
items.translation: 该类会在域类型的上下文中，对所有可达属性（无循环）进行内省，以确定哪些属性路径适用于投影。

items.source:
A factory to create projecting instances for other objects usually used to allow easy creation of representation
projections to define which properties of a domain objects shall be exported in which way.
items.translation: 工厂用于为其他对象创建投影实例，通常用于方便地定义表示投影，以指定域对象的哪些属性应以何种方式导出。

items.source: Information about a projection type.
items.translation: 投影类型的信息。
